Change ONLY frames 11–16 so the body rises as a single rigid unit through a gradual visible press: frame 11 hands under shoulders with chest/hips/thighs grounded; frame 12 barely lifted; frame 13 quarter height; frame 14 half height; frame 15 almost top; frame 16 fully straight elbows, full-body high plank. Maintain increasing elbow extension and chest/hip clearance in every consecutive frame 11–16. Keep toes anchored, straight neck-to-heel alignment during the press, both hands under shoulders, no jumping directly from bottom to top, no repeated static high-plank frames. Correct human anatomy, exactly two arms and two legs per frame, no text, labels, numbers, arrows, watermarks, borders, inset panels or extra objects.

attempts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: photorealistic 16-frame exercise animation sprite sheet for the two-mile run movement in a fitness app. Create a precise 4×4 grid of SIXTEEN EQUAL SQUARE CELLS, reading left to right then top to bottom. In every cell show the SAME adult male runner with consistent face, short dark hair, heather gray fitted T-shirt, dark charcoal athletic shorts, plain gray running shoes. Neutral light gray studio wall and floor; fixed true SIDE PROFILE camera, full body head-to-shoe visible, runner centered in each cell with equal margin on all sides. Camera, scale, lighting and background fixed; no treadmill, track, road, distance marker, props or other people. The 16 frames show exactly one smooth looping running gait cycle in place with alternating LEFT and RIGHT foot strikes, distinct physically correct phases: left foot initial ground contact; left load; left midstance; left toe-off; left early flight; left late flight/right leg forward; right foot initial ground contact; right load; right midstance; right toe-off; right early flight; right late flight/left leg forward; left foot approaches contact; left foot contact; left loading into the same pose as beginning. Opposite arms swing naturally and alternate with the legs, elbows bent; upright posture with slight forward lean, gaze forward. Make EVERY adjacent cell a small continuous pose change and frame 16 connect smoothly back to frame 1. Keep two anatomically plausible legs and two arms in each cell, clear separation between limbs, shoes both visible, no duplicated or fused legs, no extra limbs. Uniform frame geometry and realistic foot-floor contact/shadows; subtle airborne moments only where appropriate. No captions, numerals, labels, arrows, gridlines, borders, watermarks or logos. This sheet depicts running mechanics only, not two miles of distance, pace, or performance validation.
attempts.assessment: Same leading leg throughout and repeated poses; no alternating cycle.
